entities.name: Ahatanhel Krymsky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ahatanhel Yukhymovych Krymsky was a Ukrainian Orientalist, linguist, polyglot, literary scholar, folklorist, writer, and translator. He was one of the founders of the All-Ukrainian Academy of Sciences (VUAN) in 1918 and a full member of it and the Shevchenko Scientific Society from 1903.
